supplements.title: Ginkgolic acid targets HSPA8 to trigger ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via chaperone-mediated autophagy-dependent GPX4 degradation.
supplements.summary: Ginkgolic acid from Ginkgo biloba kills liver cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Polyphyllin II regulates ROS levels and promotes ferroptosis in bladder cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Polyphyllin II kills bladder cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis through increased reactive oxygen species and reduced antioxidant protein activity.

supplements.title: Acute and chronic exercise-conditioned serum effects on cancer cells in vitro: a systematic review.
supplements.summary: Acute exercise-conditioned serum inhibits growth of multiple cancer cell types in vitro, but chronic effects remain inconsistent.

supplements.title: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support for kidney cancer: a scoping review.
supplements.summary: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support interventions show promise for improving kidney cancer patient outcomes, though evidence gaps remain.

supplements.title: Fungal-derived supplements in integrative oncology.
supplements.summary: Fungal supplements show promise in supporting cancer patients' immune function and well-being, warranting greater integration into cancer care.

supplements.title: Complementary and Alternative Medicine in Oncology: A Concise Review of Utilization, Evidence, and Integration Challenges.
supplements.summary: Cancer patients widely use complementary medicine, but doctors and patients rarely discuss it, risking harmful drug interactions.

supplements.title: Therapeutic Meals, A New Approach in Oncological Integrative Care Where Medical Staff, Care Givers, and Patients Eat Together. A Qualitative Study.
supplements.summary: Shared meals between cancer patients, caregivers, and staff improve wellbeing through community connection, not just nutrition.

supplements.title: Exercise interventions for health-related quality of life, fatigue, depression, and anxiety in colorectal cancer survivors: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise improves quality of life, fatigue, depression, and anxiety in colorectal cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise modalities on psychological outcomes and quality of life in digestive system cancer survivors: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise improves depression, anxiety, and quality of life in digestive cancer survivors, with certain types proving more effective than others.

supplements.title: Illuminating Insomnia: A Scientometric Exploration of Complementary and Alternative Medicine in Treatment Research.
supplements.summary: This study maps global research trends on complementary therapies for insomnia, showing growing interest in yoga, acupuncture, and Ayurveda despite limited rigorous evidence.

supplements.title: Integrated psychosocial, sleep, and immunonutritional intervention improves psychological adaptation, sleep disturbance, and inflammatory activation in rectal cancer: a randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: A combined psychological, sleep, and nutritional program helped rectal cancer patients recover better psychologically and reduce inflammation compared to standard care.

supplements.title: Physical activity intensities and depression in colorectal cancer: interoceptive accuracy as a mediator and mindfulness as a moderator.
supplements.summary: Exercise intensity may reduce depression in colorectal cancer survivors through improved body awareness, especially for those practicing mindfulness.

supplements.title: From Focusing on Pain to Focusing on What Can Change: Results from a Feasibility and Qualitative Study on an Integrated Pain Education and Yoga Program for Women with Pain Following Breast Cancer Treatment.
supplements.summary: A combined yoga and pain education program significantly reduced pain and improved quality of life in breast cancer survivors with persistent pain.

supplements.title: [NK Cell Immunotherapy for Acute Myeloid Leukemia: Recent Advances and the Immunomodulatory Role of Traditional Chinese Medicine--Review].
supplements.summary: NK cell immunotherapy shows promise for treating acute myeloid leukemia, with traditional Chinese medicine potentially enhancing NK cell activity.

supplements.title: Atlas-Based Mapping of Traditional Chinese Medicine Effects on Tumor Microcirculation Regulation.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine may help regulate tumor blood flow, potentially reducing hypoxia and improving treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Small-molecule CBLB inhibitor abolishes EGFR ubiquitination, reduces receptor endocytosis, and diminishes cell motility signaling.
off_label.summary: A new drug blocks EGFR ubiquitination and reduces cancer cell movement in oral squamous cell carcinoma by preventing receptor internalization.

off_label.title: Research progress on chronic stress stimulation and gastric cancer metastasis.
off_label.summary: Chronic psychological stress promotes gastric cancer spread through stress hormones that activate cancer cells and suppress immune defenses.

off_label.title: [Cancer-related neuropsychiatric disorders].
off_label.summary: Cancer impairs cognitive function through brain inflammation and aging, treatable with exercise, therapy, and mindfulness.

off_label.title: Single-cell profiling of HDAC inhibitor-induced EBV lytic heterogeneity defines abortive and refractory states in B lymphoblasts.
off_label.summary: HDAC inhibitors trigger EBV reactivation in lymphomas, but only some cells succeed; NF-κB and CD137 signaling block full viral activation.

off_label.title: HNF4α-HKDC1 axis orchestrates a metabolic rewiring to promote migration and metastasis in advanced gastric cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified that blocking the HNF4α-HKDC1 pathway in gastric cancer reduces cancer spread and metastasis.

off_label.title: Association of statin use with pathological complete response in postmenopausal patients with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Statins may improve chemotherapy response in postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, though findings are preliminary and require confirmation.

off_label.title: Broad-acting antivirals: the pursuit of pan-viral therapeutics in the era of pandemics.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing broad-acting antiviral drugs to protect against multiple viruses and future pandemics, using both direct viral attacks and host-cell targeting methods.

off_label.title: Old Molecules, New Hope: A Scoping Review and Bibliometric Analysis of Drug Repurposing for Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that repurposing existing approved drugs like niclosamide and metformin shows promise for treating lung cancer more quickly and affordably.

off_label.title: Impact of beta-blockers on prognostic outcomes in solid cancers: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Beta-blockers, commonly used for heart conditions, may improve survival rates in patients with solid cancers.

off_label.title: Preoperative First-line Amlodipine in Pheochromocytoma/Paraganglioma: Perioperative Haemodynamic Instability and Its Predictors.
off_label.summary: Amlodipine as preoperative treatment for pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma helps control blood pressure swings during surgery.

off_label.title: Association of nonselective β blockers with the development of hepatocellular carcinoma in liver cirrhosis: a meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Nonselective beta blockers may help prevent hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with liver cirrhosis by reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: The 1p/19q co-deletion induces targetable and imageable vulnerabilities in glucose metabolism in oligodendrogliomas.
off_label.summary: A genetic change in oligodendrogliomas creates a weakness in how cancer cells use glucose, offering new treatment and detection opportunities.

off_label.title: Propranolol enhances the oncolytic effect of newcastle disease virus on canine mammary tumor cell by modulating the IFN-I-mediated JAK-STAT signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Propranolol enhances a cancer-killing virus's effectiveness against canine breast tumors by suppressing immune signals that normally block viral replication.

off_label.title: From Biomarker to Drug Target: Integrating ceRNA Networks and Pharmacogenomics to Reposition C5orf34 in Uterine Corpus Endometrial Cancer Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified C5orf34 as a potential new drug target for uterine cancer that could improve patient outcomes and treatment options.

off_label.title: Clomiphene citrate in the management of anovulation: a review of mechanisms, outcomes, and clinical challenges.
off_label.summary: Clomiphene citrate effectively treats anovulation by stimulating ovulation, though treatment success varies based on individual factors and has notable limitations.

biomarkers.title: Identification and characterization of a lipopolysaccharide binding, anti-inflammatory protein from Parabacteroides distasonis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a gut bacteria protein that binds harmful bacterial toxins and reduces inflammatory responses, suggesting potential therapeutic benefits.

biomarkers.title: Age-related patterns in prostate cancer: epidemiology, pathology, treatment, and survival.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers systematically compared prostate cancer incidence, pathology, treatment, and survival outcomes across different age groups.

biomarkers.title: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic strategies: DNA methylation in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: DNA methylation changes drive pancreatic cancer development and could improve diagnosis and treatment options.

biomarkers.title: Epigenetic silencing L3MBTL4 sensitizes esophageal cancer to DNA-PKcs inhibitor.
biomarkers.summary: Silencing L3MBTL4 protein makes esophageal cancer cells vulnerable to DNA-repair inhibitor drugs.

biomarkers.title: Equine genital and ocular squamous cell carcinomas: clinical, histopathological, molecular and viral characterization with proposed histopathological classification system.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified six types of horse squamous cell carcinoma and found that tumor subtype, not viral infection, predicts patient survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Porphyromonas gingivalis secreted factors drive epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) through gingipains and an H2S-mediated bacterial defense system.
biomarkers.summary: Oral bacterium P. gingivalis promotes colorectal cancer progression through secreted proteins and hydrogen sulfide, triggering cell transformation and increased motility.

biomarkers.title: Enhanced magnetic hyperthermia using anti-PD-L1 antibody-conjugated magnetoliposomes in a murine subcutaneous bladder cancer model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers combined heat therapy with immune-boosting antibodies in magnetized particles to improve bladder cancer treatment in mice.

biomarkers.title: Ginkgolic acid targets HSPA8 to trigger ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via chaperone-mediated autophagy-dependent GPX4 degradation.
biomarkers.summary: Ginkgolic acid from Ginkgo biloba kills liver cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death called ferroptosis.

biomarkers.title: Diffuse pediatric-type high grade glioma, RTK1 subtype, subclass C with SYN2::PPARG fusion in an older adult.
biomarkers.summary: A rare pediatric-type brain tumor with a novel SYN2::PPARG fusion was identified in an older adult, highlighting molecular testing's importance for accurate diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: circOMA1 delivered by exosomes regulates DRD2‑mediated prolactinoma resistance.
biomarkers.summary: CircOMA1, delivered by exosomes, drives cabergoline resistance in prolactin-secreting pituitary tumors by disrupting dopamine receptor signaling.

biomarkers.title: Targeting Mettl8-Tcf1 axis promotes CD8+ TPEX differentiation and antitumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking Mettl8 in lung cancer enhances immune cells' anti-tumor function and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: TIE2 links MEKK3-KLF2/4 and PI3K signaling in cerebral cavernous malformation.
biomarkers.summary: TIE2 receptor links two key signaling pathways in cerebral cavernous malformations, and blocking it prevents disease formation in mice.

biomarkers.title: Hypoxia‑induced exosomal CAMTA1 promotes radio‑resistance in MDA‑MB‑231 cells by regulating NRG1 to mediate M2 macrophage polarization.
biomarkers.summary: Breast cancer cells release exosomes containing CAMTA1 protein that promotes radiation resistance by converting immune cells into tumor-supporting M2 macrophages.

biomarkers.title: ZBTB7A promotes malignant phenotypes in ovarian cancer through transcriptional activation of CRLF1.
biomarkers.summary: ZBTB7A protein promotes ovarian cancer growth and spread by activating the CRLF1 gene, suggesting a new therapeutic target.

biomarkers.title: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K in cancer biology and its therapeutic applications (Review).
biomarkers.summary: hnRNPK protein regulates cancer growth and could serve as a biomarker and therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

trials.title: Age-related patterns in prostate cancer: epidemiology, pathology, treatment, and survival.
trials.summary: Researchers systematically compared prostate cancer incidence, pathology, treatment, and survival outcomes across different age groups.

trials.title: Targeting Mettl8-Tcf1 axis promotes CD8+ TPEX differentiation and antitumor immunity.
trials.summary: Blocking Mettl8 in lung cancer enhances immune cells' anti-tumor function and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: MS4322 is a selective protein arginine methyltransferase 5 degrader with antitumor effects in cervical cancer cells.
trials.summary: MS4322 drug effectively kills cervical cancer cells by blocking a protein called PRMT5 that fuels tumor growth.

trials.title: Efficacy and cost-effectiveness of lung cancer screening in France with low-dose computed tomography.
trials.summary: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening effectively saves lives in France and costs €7,629 per quality-adjusted life year gained.

trials.title: Incidental endometrial cancer diagnosis during pre-IVF workup: fertility-sparing treatment and embryo preservation.
trials.summary: Early-stage endometrial cancer was discovered during fertility workup, allowing fertility-preserving treatment and embryo storage before cancer therapy.

trials.title: Treating microsatellite unstable metastatic parathyroid carcinoma with anti-PD1 therapy.
trials.summary: Pembrolizumab immunotherapy successfully treated metastatic parathyroid carcinoma with microsatellite instability, normalizing hormone levels and shrinking tumors.

trials.title: BRAF Mutation Drives Early Multifocal Intrahepatic Recurrence after Curative Resection of Liver-Limited Colorectal Metastases.
trials.summary: BRAF mutations in colorectal cancer patients predict early, widespread cancer return in the liver after surgery.

trials.title: Prediagnostic primary care consultations and imaging in emergency-diagnosed versus referred patients with lung cancer: a population-based linked data study.
trials.summary: Lung cancer patients diagnosed through emergency care have worse outcomes than those referred through primary care.

trials.title: GP perspectives on genomics in primary care: a qualitative study on using polygenic risk scores to evaluate cancer risk.
trials.summary: Doctors could use genetic risk scores to personalize cancer screening for melanoma, colorectal, breast, and prostate cancers in primary care.

trials.title: Tyrosine phosphoproteome profiling identifies cell-intrinsic signals limiting the efficacy of tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapies.
trials.summary: Combining SFK/ABL inhibitors with standard kinase inhibitors overcomes resistance by blocking compensatory signaling that limits cancer treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Influence of acupuncture and moxibustion on postoperative gastrointestinal dysfunction among patients with gastrointestinal cancer: A network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Acupuncture and moxibustion may help gastrointestinal cancer patients recover digestive function faster after surgery with fewer side effects.

trials.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based interventions on quality of life in women breast cancer survivors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Mindfulness-based programs significantly improve quality of life and reduce psychological distress in breast cancer survivors.

trials.title: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support for kidney cancer: a scoping review.
trials.summary: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support interventions show promise for improving kidney cancer patient outcomes, though evidence gaps remain.

trials.title: Mindfulness-Oriented Recovery Enhancement for Cancer Pain Relief: Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial.
trials.summary: A mindfulness-based program called MORE effectively reduces chronic pain in cancer survivors when combined with standard treatments.

trials.title: A National Multi-Disciplinary Integrative Oncology Training Program in Israel: Trainee Perspectives.
trials.summary: A new Israeli training program teaches healthcare professionals integrative approaches to support cancer patients' well-being alongside standard treatment.

mind_body.title: The role of acupuncture in managing hyperhidrosis and vasomotor sweating: Evidence, mechanisms, and gaps.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture shows promise as a non-drug treatment for excessive sweating and hot flushes, though more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.

mind_body.title: Influence of acupuncture and moxibustion on postoperative gastrointestinal dysfunction among patients with gastrointestinal cancer: A network meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture and moxibustion may help gastrointestinal cancer patients recover digestive function faster after surgery with fewer side effects.

mind_body.title: The Spiritual Experiences of Indonesian Women With Advanced Breast Cancer: A Phenomenological Study.
mind_body.summary: Indonesian women with advanced breast cancer use spiritual practices like prayer and religious devotion as essential coping resources for emotional resilience and peace.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based interventions on quality of life in women breast cancer survivors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based programs significantly improve quality of life and reduce psychological distress in breast cancer survivors.

mind_body.title: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support for kidney cancer: a scoping review.
mind_body.summary: Exercise, nutrition, and psychological support interventions show promise for improving kidney cancer patient outcomes, though evidence gaps remain.

mind_body.title: Fungal-derived supplements in integrative oncology.
mind_body.summary: Fungal supplements show promise in supporting cancer patients' immune function and well-being, warranting greater integration into cancer care.

mind_body.title: A National Multi-Disciplinary Integrative Oncology Training Program in Israel: Trainee Perspectives.
mind_body.summary: A new Israeli training program teaches healthcare professionals integrative approaches to support cancer patients' well-being alongside standard treatment.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on Breathlessness in Lung Cancer: A Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions effectively reduce breathlessness, the most distressing symptom experienced by lung cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Spiritual Distress Screening by Nurses to Increase Comprehensive Spiritual Support of Patients.
mind_body.summary: Nurse screening for spiritual distress in breast cancer patients increased chaplaincy referrals and improved comprehensive support delivery.

mind_body.title: Effect of Acupuncture and Massage on Pain in Adolescent and Young Adult Patients with Advanced Cancer: Subgroup Analysis of a Randomized Clinical Trial.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture and massage reduced pain in adolescent and young adult patients with advanced cancer.

mind_body.title: Sleep Impairment and Chronic Pain in the Military: A Scoping Review.
mind_body.summary: Military personnel with chronic pain and sleep problems benefit from non-medication therapies like behavioral and mind-body interventions.

mind_body.title: Group medical visits in cancer survivorship care: a scoping review.
mind_body.summary: Group medical visits help cancer survivors address unmet physical, emotional, and informational needs through combined care, education, and peer support.

mind_body.title: Correlates and patterns of using complementary health approaches among individuals with recent and longer-term cancer diagnoses: a US national cross-sectional study.
mind_body.summary: Many cancer survivors use complementary health practices like meditation and yoga, with patterns varying by diagnosis recency.

mind_body.title: Mindfulness, Psychological Resilience, and Social Function Deficits in Young and Middle-Aged Lymphoma Patients: A Latent Profile and Mediation Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness helps lymphoma patients maintain better social functioning by building psychological resilience.
